issues: No sign of getting around the measurement. The new choice of the power p and the noise s2 uses only the training fold, through an inner GroupKFold split by Murcko scaffold. It reads no files and never touches test labels.

No bug that makes the result meaningless. Raising a Tanimoto kernel to a power element by element keeps it a valid kernel (by the Schur product theorem). The same p is applied to both K_tr and K_te in the final prediction.
Small naming issue: choose_sigma2 now returns a pair (p, s2), so the name is out of date. This is cosmetic.
The inner search is now 9 settings instead of 3, so it costs about 3 times as much. The 10-minute limit was not hit.

My recomputed z is about -0.57 ((0.4968 - 0.5017) / (0.0070 * sqrt(1 + 1/2))). The harness reports -0.559, and the small gap is likely from rounding of the stored means. The candidate is slightly worse and the difference is within noise, so the decision to reject stands.
